lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are positioned posterior to the gill slits. A primary group of four high-intensity nodes forms a rectangular-staggered arrangement in the mid-flank area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are observable intersecting with the primary blobs on the posterior half of the visible flank, forming a partial grid-like structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct longitudinal feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gills displays a high density of micro-spots, transitioning to larger, more discrete blobs as the flank moves posteriorly.
